## Where I stand
The PostgreSQL 17 upgrade is done on staging. `analytics-staging` has run 17.2 since the blue/green switchover at 14:20 UTC on Nov 17, with 41 seconds of refused writes. The pg_partman 5.1.0 upgrade and the dbt run (14/14 models passing) are also done. Production is not started: it needs a reboot for `rds.logical_replication` before its own blue/green switchover, and no date is set until Maya signs off. (source: ses-pg-3, s3-06, s3-08, s3-02, src-slack-infra)

- [en-cours] Staging has to run on 17 for a full week before production sign-off. Noa asked to be pinged if anything looks off this week. (source: s3-09, src-slack-infra, src-linear-kes298)
- [prochaine-étape] Keep watching staging on 17.2 through the week. (source: s3-09, src-linear-kes298)
- [prochaine-étape] Production step 0: set `rds.logical_replication = 1` and reboot, which needs its own window of about 2–3 minutes of downtime, before creating the blue/green deployment. The runbook already says so. (source: s3-10, s3-09)
- [prochaine-étape] Once Maya signs off, pick the production window, outside the dbt lock at 01:00–03:30 UTC. (source: s1-05, s1-04, src-linear-kes298)
- [essai-raté] Applying the staging plan failed at blue/green creation: the source parameter group needed `rds.logical_replication = 1` and a reboot. Fixed in commit 7e3c9d4. (source: s3-04, 7e3c9d4)
- [essai-raté] `terraform init -upgrade` pulled AWS provider v6.4.0, which produced 37 unrelated changes. Pinned back to 5.82. (source: s1-01, s1-02)
- [question] The production cutover date is not decided. A note suggests Saturday Nov 28, 04:00 UTC, but no one has confirmed it. (source: src-note-cutover, src-linear-kes298)
- [décision] No production date until Maya signs off. (source: s1-04)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to 5.82, no v6 in this PR. (source: s1-02)
- [décision] Production will get the logical replication reboot before the blue/green deployment. (source: s3-09)
